name: Ominous blind date
source:
You go on a blind date but didn't realize you were going on three different dates. Pick one of three normal dates. Get to know them and their deepest, and darkest secrets. Just kidding.

[From [url=https://notaghost01.itch.io/ominous-blind-date]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你去相亲，但没有意识到你们正在进行三个不同的约会。选择三个正常日期之一。了解他们以及他们最深、最黑暗的秘密。只是在开玩笑。

[来自[url=https://notaghost01.itch.io/ominous-blind-date]Itch.io[/url]]
